titleKm: ពាក្យសន្យា
text: Long ago the people of this place made a promise to the guardians of the forest. Each season they gave thanks, and the forest gave back.

titleKm: របស់ដែលត្រូវបានយក
text: Then one hand reached into the forest's heart and took what was never offered. The shrines went quiet that night.

titleKm: អ្នកការពារដែលត្រូវបានធ្វើបាប
text: The Neak Ta did not curse the people. They only withdrew, grieving, and left the paths unguarded.

titleKm: វិញ្ញាណដែលមិនស្ងប់
text: Where balance breaks, restless spirits gather. Ap and Arak wander the dark, drawn to the wound in the forest.

titleKm: បេះដូងនៃព្រៃ
text: The forest closes around what was taken, and waits. Seek the Heart of the Forest, and carry an offering.
